newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsui High-tec's 96/97 earnings seen down -paper.
newsitem.headline: Mitsui High-tec's 96/97 earnings seen down -paper.

text.p: Mitsui High-tec Inc is expected to suffer from a fall in parent sales and profit in the year to January 31, 1997, due to the sluggish global semiconductor market, a Japanese newspaper said on Thursday.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun economic daily expects Mitsui's 1996/97 parent sales to be about 31.8 billion yen, down four percent from a year ago.
It said that the company's parent current profit would be about 4.6 billion yen in 1996/97, down eight percent from a year ago. Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
